DEC-ARCH-001.title: Deployment pathway
DEC-ARCH-001.discoveryQuestion: Is this a new deployment, an import/conversion, or an in-place upgrade?

DEC-ARCH-002.title: Platform architecture model
DEC-ARCH-002.discoveryQuestion: Will management and workloads use consolidated, standard, or disaggregated infrastructure?

DEC-FLEET-001.title: Fleet boundary
DEC-FLEET-001.discoveryQuestion: Which VCF instances share one fleet-level operations and governance boundary?

DEC-FLEET-002.title: VCF instance strategy
DEC-FLEET-002.discoveryQuestion: Will the design use one VCF instance or multiple instances by region, regulation, scale or recovery role?

impliedDecisions.note: Multi-instance often pairs with site replication / Fleet DR

DEC-WLD-001.title: Workload-domain boundary
DEC-WLD-001.discoveryQuestion: How should clusters be grouped into workload domains?

DEC-AVAIL-002.title: Availability objective
DEC-AVAIL-002.discoveryQuestion: What availability target applies to control planes and workloads?

DEC-NET-001.title: Networking consumption model
DEC-NET-001.discoveryQuestion: Will tenants consume centrally managed segments or self-service VPC networking?

DEC-NET-002.title: Transit routing model
DEC-NET-002.discoveryQuestion: Should VPC connectivity be centralized or distributed?

DEC-NET-003.title: Physical underlay topology
DEC-NET-003.discoveryQuestion: Is the physical fabric shared Layer 2, stretched Layer 2, or routed Layer 3?

DEC-NET-004.title: Required network services
DEC-NET-004.discoveryQuestion: Which stateful services are required: NAT, load balancing, VPN, firewall or threat prevention?

DEC-NET-005.title: Gateway appliance placement
DEC-NET-005.discoveryQuestion: When appliances are required, should they use shared compute or a dedicated edge cluster?

DEC-NET-006.title: Host uplink profile
DEC-NET-006.discoveryQuestion: Will traffic share two uplinks or use four or more physically separated uplinks?

DEC-NET-007.title: VPC connectivity policy
DEC-NET-007.discoveryQuestion: Should VPCs be isolated, grouped in communities, or connected to shared services?

DEC-NET-008.title: VPC network span
DEC-NET-008.discoveryQuestion: Which clusters may host each VPC subnet?

DEC-STG-001.title: Primary storage topology
DEC-STG-001.discoveryQuestion: Will storage be hyperconverged, a disaggregated vSAN storage cluster, or external?

DEC-STG-002.title: vSAN architecture
DEC-STG-002.discoveryQuestion: When vSAN is selected, is ESA or OSA required?

DEC-STG-003.discoveryQuestion: Will compute mount local-only, shared or mixed OSA/ESA remote vSAN datastores?

DEC-STG-004.title: Storage efficiency services
DEC-STG-004.discoveryQuestion: Should compression and global deduplication be included in capacity assumptions?

DEC-STG-005.title: Encryption scope
DEC-STG-005.discoveryQuestion: Is encryption required at rest, in transit, both, or not by platform policy?

DEC-PROT-002.discoveryQuestion: What RPO, RTO and retention objectives must the platform support?

DEC-ID-001.title: Identity Broker topology
DEC-ID-001.discoveryQuestion: Should Identity Broker be embedded, appliance-based, or three-node HA?

DEC-ID-003.discoveryQuestion: Will passwords remain platform-managed or integrate with an enterprise vault?

DEC-LCM-001.title: Lifecycle strategy
DEC-LCM-001.discoveryQuestion: Will operations use standard maintenance, rolling evacuation, or live patch where eligible?

DEC-OPS-001.title: Operations deployment topology
DEC-OPS-001.discoveryQuestion: What placement and HA model is required for VCF Operations?

DEC-OPS-002.discoveryQuestion: Which logs, flow data, retention and remote collectors are required?

DEC-OPS-003.title: Operational governance
DEC-OPS-003.discoveryQuestion: Will fleet tags, compliance and cost/showback be centrally governed?

DEC-AUTO-002.title: Placement governance
DEC-AUTO-002.discoveryQuestion: Which infrastructure policies govern placement, licensing and data locality?

DEC-VKS-003.discoveryQuestion: Will VKS use VDS, NSX VPC, overlay-only, or multiple node/pod networks?

DEC-AI-001.discoveryQuestion: Will the design include VCF Private AI services?

DEC-AI-002.discoveryQuestion: What training/inference, retention, checkpoint and east-west fabric profile is required?

DEC-SEC-001.title: Advanced security services
DEC-SEC-001.discoveryQuestion: Which micro-segmentation, IDS/IPS and malware-prevention services are required?

DEC-MOB-001.title: Workload mobility
DEC-MOB-001.discoveryQuestion: Will HCX or another mobility service be used for migration or network extension?

DEC-COST-001.title: Licensing and cost model
DEC-COST-001.discoveryQuestion: What licensing, chargeback/showback and capacity-planning model is required?

DEC-EDGE-001.discoveryQuestion: Which validated edge operating pattern fits each remote site profile?
